prompt.alinti: Number three on GitHub today. A plugin for AI coding agents that says it cuts wasted context by 98%. It's called Context Mode by Mert Koseoglu. Agents can dump huge tool results into their context. One browser snapshot can take 56 kilobytes. Context Mode runs that work in a sandbox and sends back only the answer. To count lines in 50 files, the agent writes a script instead of loading them into context. It also tracks edits, tasks, and decisions locally, so after compaction, the agent can pick up where you left off. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more. The catch? 98% is its own benchmark. Without hooks, it estimates 60% saved. And it's source-available, not open-source. Would you install it?
